## Plugin reference

- Description: The workspace demo's story, as data: the agents' stories and transcripts, Demo's pages, prototypes' tags, songs and places — what the demo's build-time seed writes through each app's fixture writer, kept apart from the demo's scenario so the page that embeds the demo never bundles the apps this data names.
- Core:
  - Uses: 24 symbols — full list in [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md)
    - `infra/namespace` ×5
    - `apps/prototypes/files` ×4
    - `conversations/before-after` ×3
    - `conversations/agents` ×2
    - `conversations/model-provider.ConversationModelSchema`
    - `conversations.CONVERSATIONS_CATEGORY_ID`
    - `infra/mcp.agentToolName`
    - `packages/string-hash.hashHex`
    - `page/editor.blockIdKind`
    - `page/inline-date.dateToken`
    - `page/inline-page-link.pageLinkToken`
    - `page/prompt/link.PAGES_CATEGORY_ID`
    - `ui/icons/emoji.EmojiSchema`
    - `wish.WISHES_CATEGORY_ID`
  - Exports (types):
    - `DemoAgent`
    - `DemoBeforeAfter`
    - `DemoBeforeAfterRegistration`
    - `DemoBeforeAfterRegistrations`
    - `DemoPageSession`
    - `DemoPageToolCall`
    - `DemoStory`
  - Exports (values):
    - `DEMO_AGENTS`
    - `DEMO_BEFORE_AFTERS`
    - `DEMO_PAGE_IDS`
    - `DEMO_PAGES`
    - `DEMO_PLACES`
    - `DEMO_PRACTICE_TIMER_BEFORE_AFTER`

    - `DEMO_SONG_ID`
    - `DEMO_STORIES`
    - `demoAgentId`
    - `demoAgentLaunchId`
    - `demoAttemptId`
    - `demoConversationId`
    - `demoPromptOf`
    - `demoPrototypeFixture`
    - `demoPushSha`
    - `demoSongs`
    - `demoStoryByKey`
    - `demoTaskId`
    - `demoTranscriptJsonl`
    - `demoWorktreePath`
    - `PRACTICE_TIMER_PAGE_WORK`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/website/demos/workspace`
    - `apps/website/landing/screenshot`
- Test helpers:
  - Core: `@plugins/apps/plugins/website/plugins/demos/plugins/workspace/plugins/story/core/testing`
    - `DEMO_FEATURED_PROTOTYPE` — The prototype the demo's pages and transcripts point at (the photo grid).
    - `DEMO_FILE_SONGS` — The file-backed songs' ids and titles, for the boot test to assert.
    - `DEMO_PROTOTYPE_TAGS` — The demo's prototype tags, in gallery order, and which prototype carries which.
    - `DEMO_SONGS` — The chord grids: authored text, so the story can assert them as written.
